result.paraphrase: G-RAID with Thunderbolt 3 is an ultra-fast, high-capacity dual-drive Enterprise-class 7200RPM hard drive storage system with multiple RAID choices for maximum flexibility and reliability. Drive: 7200RPM. Interfaces: (2) Thunderbolt 3, (1) USB-C (USB 3.1 Gen 2), and (1) HDMI (HDCP 2.2 supports 4K 60/HDR). Transfer rate: up to 500MB/s. This high-performance storage solution includes removable drives and is built for demanding applications, with support for multi-stream HD, 2K, 4K, and HDR video workflows. Performance features include up to 24TB of storage, hardware RAID, dual removable Enterprise-class 7200RPM HDDs, an HDMI port ready for 4K 60FPS and HDR, daisy-chaining for 5 additional devices, dual Thunderbolt 3 ports and a USB-C port, and transfer rates up to 500MB/s.
